CUSTOM_PS_INGR_MACRO.shared: Same clip as in 4010f985: generate ONCE and reuse in all 5 PS general-ad rebuilds.
CUSTOM_PS_INGR_MACRO.keyframe: Vertical 9:16 premium skincare studio macro, clean L'Oreal-style lighting: soft white key light from top-left, gentle lavender rim light, seamless pale-lavender-to-white background, glossy white acrylic surface with a soft reflection. Centre-bottom: one smooth, glossy, opaque pale-lavender sunscreen cream swirl (light and creamy, not watery, not paste). Upper-left: a single crystal-clear water-light serum droplet (niacinamide) hanging just above the swirl, catching a bright specular highlight. Right side: a thin clear-glass disc standing upright, catching a crisp warm sunbeam that refracts into a soft prism flare (sun-protection cue). The three elements are clearly separated, with clean empty background above each for labels added in post. No product packaging, no hands, no people, no text, no letters, no logos.
CUSTOM_PS_INGR_MACRO.motion: The serum droplet falls in slow motion onto the lavender swirl and makes a soft silky ripple; the sunbeam glints across the glass disc; very slow macro push-in; nothing else changes.

rebuild.notes: Miniature-city shots are dropped for a real-life premium look. Current shot 1 (tube above the city) could still be a 1 s cold open if the client liked the city idea. No canopy, rings or cross-sections. The only woman is MEERA. New credits: one shared PS CUSTOM clip.
rebuild.vo_budget_note: English VO is about 235 characters over 16.4 s. The regional dubs (spoken at about 14 chars/s, with numbers spoken as words, e.g. 'SPF fifty PA triple plus') will run longer, so transcreate tightly. If a language overflows, trim connectives first, never the ingredient names, 'Instant Glow' or the full product name.
